column4: First-depositor inflation drains deposit in Vault
column5: First-depositor inflation drains deposit in Vault -- ### Summary `Vault.sol:deposit()` prices new shares off the raw asset balance with no virtual offset, so after a 1-wei seed a donated-asset spike makes the next honest deposit mint zero shares. ### Root Cause In `Vault.sol` the deposit share math reads balanceOf directly.

column4: Rounding in settleEpoch favors the protocol
column5: Rounding in settleEpoch favors the protocol -- ### Summary `Vault.sol:settleEpoch()` floors division on every settlement, so the protocol keeps a systematic one-wei bias. ### Root Cause floor division instead of a rounding-mode parameter.

column4: Stale oracle answer lets a borrow price off a halted feed
column5: Stale oracle answer lets a borrow price off a halted feed -- ### Summary `Oracle.sol:peekPrice()` returns the last cached answer without comparing updatedAt against a staleness window, so a halted feed keeps quoting a dead price to the borrow path. ### Root Cause In `Oracle.sol` peekPrice reads the cached answer unconditionally.
